gltf_axes: glTF(x,y,z) = (-E, U, N); Unity import (x negated) -> (E, U, N)
instances: Data/raw/derived/<id>/world/instances_<ci>_<cj>.json: point instances {p: prototype, e, n, z, yaw [, sz scale z][, h/v/lean for trees]} of art-source/world/props/street_props.glb and art-source/world/vegetation/trees.glb (+ trees_lod2.glb impostors)

nodes.bridge: bridge decks, soffits, parapets, abutments, piers (low confidence)
nodes.buildings: LOD0 buildings with openings, docks, roofs
nodes.buildings_lod1: LOD1 prisms with the same wall materials
nodes.forest_hlod_<i>_<j>: forest HLOD cell (64 m): canopy + alpha-tested edge walls; draw it instead of the trees with instance field fc = <i>_<j> when the cell bbox is farther than lod_policy.<profile>.forest_hlod_m; textures: material extras texture_ref (art-source/world/vegetation/forest_*.png)
nodes.furniture: linear furniture: fences, guard rails, noise barriers, retaining walls, wires
nodes.markings: horizontal markings decal mesh (lift 0.006 m, use depth offset)
nodes.paved: yards, parking lots, dock aprons, set-back paths + edging; TEXCOORD_1 = (distance to the area edge m, distance to a building wall m)
nodes.road: ground-level road surfaces: carriageways, junction patches, kerbs, sidewalks; TEXCOORD_1 = (lane coordinate, distance to carriageway edge m)
nodes.road_collision: collision: smooth road surfaces (4 m stations, no flanges), paved areas, LOD1 buildings, fences/rails/walls; one primitive per surface material
nodes.terrain_lod<k>: terrain LODs (with skirts); COLOR_0 = ground masks (R dist to road/20 m, G forest floor, B unmown, A bare soil)

units: metres; local E = x - origin.x, N = y - origin.y; heights absolute PL-EVRF2007-NH
